# BadgeOverlap

`Flare.Components.BadgeOverlap`

Shape of the anchor element that determines how the badge indicator overlaps its edge.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Circular` | `0` | Anchor element has a circular shape (e.g. avatar); badge is positioned at the curved edge. |
| `Rectangular` | `1` | Anchor element has a rectangular shape; badge is positioned at the corner. |
